answer: In Timur Laut, 33% of residents live within 1 km of a public clinic by road. In Seberang Perai Selatan, 20% live more than 3 km away. For schools, the largest share more than 3 km away is 13%, in Seberang Perai Tengah; for Rapid Penang stops, it is 29%, in Seberang Perai Selatan.

keyNumbers.label: of Seberang Perai Selatan residents live more than 3 km by road from a public clinic.
keyNumbers.caveat: 21% with Meta's 30 m population map instead of WorldPop.

keyNumbers.label: public clinics, schools and Rapid Penang stops mapped.
keyNumbers.caveat: Dental clinics and private clinics are not included; facility records are dated 2013 to 2022.

keyNumbers.label: of Penang residents live within 1 km by road of a Rapid Penang stop.
keyNumbers.caveat: Stops from the GTFS feed retrieved on 14 October 2026; distance says nothing about how often buses run.
